checks.question: Revise the supplied 80 × 45 × 8 mm slotted plate, keeping its outer box, pose and material. Replace both existing obround through-slots. Their new row centres are Y=−13 and +13 mm relative to the plate centre. Each new slot runs along X with radius-3 mm semicircular ends centred at X=−16 and +16 mm, giving a 6 mm width and 38 mm total length. Fully fill the portions of the old, wider slots that lie outside the new openings; do not leave both patterns. At (X,Y)=(−30,0) and (30,0), add diameter-5 mm through-holes. Counterbore each from the top face to diameter 9 mm and depth 3 mm. The plate bottom remains at Z=0. Keep the slot walls vertical, the counterbore shoulders flat, and all unintended areas unchanged. Each slot and each drilled hole must remain a separate open passage.；按本题允许修改范围检查形态或照明变化，N中已计的尺寸/数量不在此重复计分。
